claims: NCAA.com and USA Today reported that the 2026 Men's Final Four will be held at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana.
NCAA.com and USA Today reported that the 2026 Men's Final Four games will be on April 4 and 6, 2026.
USA Today reported that the 2026 Men's Final Four marks the ninth time Indianapolis has hosted the Men's Final Four.
USA Today reported that the 2026 Men's Final Four marks the fourth time the Men's Final Four has been held at Lucas Oil Stadium.
This video shows the court being installed for the 2026 Final Four at Lucas Oil Stadium.
